## Teaching QA

- [ ] Minimum viable takeaway is explicit.
- [ ] Core path fits the 80-minute session and the first cut is named.
- [ ] Core and continuation lanes are visibly separate.
- [ ] Guided and completed-reference materials agree.
- [ ] Tiered hints and a recovery/rejoin checkpoint exist.
- [ ] Exit ticket has expected reasoning and a response plan.
- [ ] Instructions are written as well as spoken and plots are accessible.

## Technical and scientific QA

- [ ] Notebook JSON/code validates and paired Jupytext source is synchronized.
- [ ] Core notebook restarts and runs top-to-bottom in the supported environment.
- [ ] Paths are project-relative; outputs contain no usernames, credentials, or private data.
- [ ] Units, dimensions/columns, missingness, flags, assumptions, and source are checked.
- [ ] Network acquisition has been preflighted and downstream work runs from a local/recovery file.
- [ ] Data/license/attribution changes are documented.
- [ ] Provider raw, recovery, generated, and student files are absent from the commit.
